numbering_basis: Release order of the five 「新テニスの王子様 OVA vs Genius10」 discs (Vol.1-Vol.5, 2014-10-29 -> 2015-06-26), one 4-koma anime 『放課後の王子様』 block per disc as a 映像特典. The licensor numbers the HOST OVA's own episodes 第1話-第10話 but prints NO number for the 4-koma blocks, so this run's numbering is ours: 1..5 in disc order. Dates are the discs' Japanese on-sale dates, identical on the licensor's product pages, the licensor's news posts and ja-WP's per-volume table (day-of-week checked: Wed / Thu / Fri / Fri / Fri, exactly as the licensor prints them).

flags_for_sean: TASK PREMISE CORRECTED: the shorts are NOT bundled with the Prince of Tennis 'Zenkoku Taikai-hen' Blu-ray box and were not a standalone stream. They are the 映像特典 4-koma anime on the five 「新テニスの王子様 OVA vs Genius10」 discs (2014-10-29 -> 2015-06-26), each disc carrying two OVA episodes of that OTHER work plus one 放課後の王子様 block. Licensor + ja-WP + ANN all say so.

COUNT: 5 rows = AniList's 5 (no mismatch). The count basis is one 4-koma block per disc, and the disc dates bracket the entry exactly: MAL 'Oct 29, 2014 to Jun 26, 2015' and Kitsu 2014-10-29/2015-06-26 = Vol.1 and Vol.5.

NO OFFICIAL PER-EPISODE TITLES. The licensor prints one heading per disc (４コマアニメ『放課後の王子様』) and then lists the CONSTITUENT 4-koma segment titles, every list ending 「ほか」/「などを収録」 - so each disc's block holds MORE segments than are named. The row titles in this grid are CONSTRUCTED disc labels ('… vs Genius10 Vol.N bonus'); the named segments are in each row's note. If the catalog prefers content-bearing titles, the segment lists are the only printed material - Sean's call.

A SIXTH 放課後 VIDEO UNIT EXISTS, outside AniList's 5: the 「新テニスの王子様 OVA vs Genius10 FAN DISC」 (2015-12-24, BCXA-1087 / BCBA-4747) carries (a) 「放課後の王子様」番外編ピクチャードラマ『毒草聖書外伝〜白石探偵走る〜』 and (b) 'DVD未収録４コマアニメ「放課後の王子様」' = 「ダメだし ダメおし ダメチョップ」「３の６」「憂える不二」. NOT added as row 6 (AniList counts 5 and the FAN DISC is a separate product) - flagged so the decision is explicit.

A PRE-DISC WEB BLOCK: the licensor's 2014-08-15 news post dates the animate 「新テニスの王子様フェア」 2014-08-23 -> 2014-09-23, whose postcard serial code unlocked 「放課後の王子様」特別編 viewing; the FAN DISC page says three of those web shorts stayed off the DVDs until 2015-12-24. So row 1's 2014-10-29 is the first DISC release, not necessarily the first release of every segment inside it (the fandom logged 「だって」/「丸井改名」 on 2014-08-28, inside the web window, and neither title appears in any disc list - they may sit under a disc list's 「ほか」). No exact per-short web dates are published; the honest value is the disc date.

SOURCE DEFECT (licensor site): the live Vol.2 product page http://tenipuri.jp/dvd_bd/09/02.html has lost its 初回特典 block, so the live page alone would read as 'no 4-koma on Vol.2'. The 2014-12-30 Wayback snapshot and the 2014-10-28 news post both carry it, and the page still shows the ©許斐 剛・佐倉ケンイチ credit line (the 放課後 co-credit) that only appears on discs carrying the short. Also: tenipuri.jp REFUSES HTTPS (connection refused on :443) - it must be fetched over HTTP.

ROW SPACE WARNING for whoever does the standing pass: princeoftennis.fandom's 'List of The Prince of After School Episodes' is a 16-SEGMENT list, not a 5-episode list, and it is incomplete/mixed (see sources). Do not join our 5 rows to it by index.

SHARED-DISC IDENTITY: every row's release is a disc of 新テニスの王子様 OVA vs Genius10, which is its own AniList entry (10 episodes over these same 5 dates). If that work ever enters the catalog, the two entries must not share rows - the dates will collide by construction.
